1. A farmer has a pile of kitchen waste, slashed grass, and dry leaves shown below.
 State two steps the farmer should follow to turn the above materials into compost manure.

2. The picture below shows two methods of watering plants.
 (a) Name the method of watering labelled F _________________________________
 (1 mark)
 (b) Which method of watering conserves water? _____________________ (1 mark)
3. A Grade 4 learner has collected the following materials for constructing a scarecrow to
 control wild animals in the school garden.
@ 2024 Kenya National Examinations Council Grade 4 Agriculture and Nutrition SBA 2
 (a) Name one other object that the learner requires __________________________
 (1 mark)
 (b) Give one use of each of the following as the learner constructs the scarecrow:
 (i) Grass _______________________________________________(1 mark)
 (i) Thread_____________________________________________ (1 mark)
4. Below is a list of activities carried out when sowing tiny carrot seeds in the seedbed.
 (i) Cover the seeds lightly with soil and press down.
 (ii) Evenly distribute the tiny carrot seeds along the furrows.
 (iii) Make shallow furrows in the soil using a stick or your finger.
 (iv) Prepare the soil by loosening it and removing any weeds or debris.
 Arrange the activities in the correct order. (2 marks)
 (i) _______________________________________________________________
 (ii) _______________________________________________________________
 (iii) _______________________________________________________________
 (iv) _______________________________________________________________
5. The picture below shows a Grade 4 learner planting a guava fruit tree.
 (a) How did the learner prepare the soil for planting the fruit tree? (1 mark)
 (b) State two caring practices the learner will carry after planting. (2 marks)
@ 2024 Kenya National Examinations Council Grade 4 Agriculture and Nutrition SBA 3
6. The following is a list of different domestic animals. State the main use of each of the
 animals in the farm. (3 marks)
 Animal Main use on the farm
 Cows
 Chicken
 Donkey
7. A family uses firewood for cooking but wants to conserve fuel. State three ways they can
 conserve firewood while cooking. (3 marks)
8. Sarah was served with rice, beans, spinach, and a ripe banana for lunch.
 (a) Indicate whether Sarah’s meal is a balanced diet or not by ticking in the
 appropriate box. (1 mark)
 YES
 Balanced diet
 (b) Name the main nutrient supplied by each of the following food substance in
 Sarah’s meal: (2 marks)
 (i) Beans _________________________________________________________
 (ii) Spinach ________________________________________________________
9. Tom wants to shallow fry fish fillet. The following are the steps he intends to follow:
 (i) Cook until golden brown on one side; then flip to cook the other side.
 (ii) Heat oil in a frying pan over medium heat.
 (iii) Place fish fillets gently into the hot oil.
 (iv) Place on paper towels to drain excess oil.
 (v) Remove the fish from pan using spatula once fully cooked.
 (vi) Season the fish fillets with salt and spices.
@ 2024 Kenya National Examinations Council Grade 4 Agriculture and Nutrition SBA 4
 Arrange the steps in the correct order. (3 marks)
10. The Nutrition teacher asked learners to always maintain proper hygiene.
 a) Outline four steps the learners should follow when washing their hands. (2 marks)
 b) State three reasons why the learners should properly dispose kitchen refuse to
 maintain hygiene at home. (3 marks)
11. A learner hanged clothes on a clothesline to dry after washing. Outline three reasons for
 drying the clothes. (3 marks)
@ 2024 Kenya National Examinations Council Grade 4 Agriculture and Nutrition SBA 5

 (a) Identify the tacking stitch labelled:
